# cache folder

This folder is used to store temporary files that are automatically generated by tools.
The settings are done in the Project Settings.
For more detail, see Specify Folders for Derived Files in the documentation.

- [Manage Project Settings, Path, Labels, and Startup and Shutdown Tasks][doc-project-settings]

[doc-project-settings]: https://www.mathworks.com/help/matlab/matlab_prog/manage-project-settings-path-labels-and-startup-and-shutdown-tasks.html
